content_units: Smart-Choices-Gone-Wrong Movie Night

For 6 adults, this lineup fits your rules cleanly: 3 standalone English-language films, no franchise entries, each under 140 minutes, with a total event time of   5 hours 40 minutes   including   two 20-minute snack breaks  .
3-Film Lineup and Watch Order
Film   Year   Runtime   Why it fits the theme   Snack pairing
Ex Machina     2014     108 min     Brilliant people build and test something they absolutely do not control.     Minimalist charcuterie cups + cucumber water
Burn After Reading     2008     96 min     Everyone thinks they are being clever; nearly everyone is disastrously wrong.     “CIA Crunch” snack mix
Nightcrawler     2014     117 min     A highly intelligent opportunist keeps making sharper, darker choices as he gains power.     Midnight sliders + cold brew brownies
Total film runtime:   321 minutes
Two snack breaks:   40 minutes
Total event time:     361 minutes / 6 hours 1 minute
Why This Order Works Best
1) Ex Machina
- Best opener: sleek, focused, and immediately on-theme.
- Gets the room thinking without exhausting everyone early.
- Its cool, controlled tone sets up the night well.
Snack pairing:   Minimalist charcuterie cups + cucumber water
- Sharp cheddar, green grapes, crackers, salami
- Clean, high-design presentation matches the film’s sterile tech vibe
- Easy to eat before the first break or during setup
2) Burn After Reading
- Perfect middle slot because it releases tension with dark comedy.
- Keeps the “smart people, terrible judgment” idea going in a more chaotic way.
- Great energy reset after the cool precision of the first film.
Snack pairing:   “CIA Crunch” snack mix
- Pretzels, smoked almonds, bagel chips, wasabi peas, M&M’s
- Serve in labeled paper envelopes or small bowls for the spy-bungling theme
- Salty, crunchy, low-mess break food
3) Nightcrawler
- Strong closer: the most intense and morally corrosive film of the three.
- Ends the night with the sharpest discussion potential.
- Feels bigger and more propulsive late in the evening.
Snack pairing:   Midnight sliders + cold brew brownies
- Mini beef or mushroom sliders for something more substantial
- Coffee brownies fit the late-night L.A. media-hustle mood
- Best final-film food because the movie has real momentum
Hosting Flow for the Evening
-   Start:   Ex Machina — 108 min
-   Break 1:   20 min
-   Second:   Burn After Reading — 96 min
-   Break 2:   20 min
-   Finale:   Nightcrawler — 117 min
Suggested tone arc:   cerebral → absurd → unsettling
